en.askTitle: Swap in your own family, dates and budget, and get the same costed ski-week plan
en.runTitle: Hong Kong family of four, 6 nights in Niseko on HK$60,000 including flights

fields.label: Dates
fields.value: 6 nights in Niseko during the Hong Kong school Lunar New Year break, February 2027

fields.label: Ski experience and lesson language
fields.value: All beginners except one adult who skis a little

en.template: Help us plan Niseko from Hong Kong for {dates}, {party}, {experience}, {budget} and {needs}. Separate confirmed quotes from allowances. Match flights, family beds, lessons, passes, transfers and ski insurance before recommending commitments. Ask before contacting anyone or making a booking.

phases.title: Look up school holiday dates, flights, transfers, lodging and ski costs from public sources
phases.note: Lodging, flights and transfers, and ski costs researched side by side
phases.judgment: It did not pretend to have quotes it never found: there is no fare for the target week and no confirmed available family room for those exact dates, so the later-February fares are labelled as comparisons, not quotes.

phases.title: Build a saving budget and a comfortable one, then write the page and sources
phases.note: Budgets in HKD with every calculation shown
phases.judgment: The independent check caught a flaw: the saving plan returned rented outerwear before the tubing day. Fixing it moved the totals to HK$66,279 (saving plan, still over the HK$60,000 cap) and HK$59,849 (strict compromise, leaving HK$151 under the cap).

phases.title: Open the page at desktop and phone width and check the arithmetic again

workers: Looked for real Niseko lodging with published family prices, bed set-ups and booking and cancellation terms
Checked flights from Hong Kong, ski-gear baggage rules, how to get from the airport to Niseko, and Japan entry and insurance
Collected this season’s lift pass, kids’ and adult lesson, rental and tubing prices and the peak-date rules
Cleaned up the wording of the page and source notes without changing a single number
Recalculated every budget line from the raw figures, independently of whoever built the budget

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的家庭、日期和预算，得到同样带价钱的滑雪周计划
zh.runTitle: 香港四口之家，预算 6 万港元（含机票），二世古 6 晚

fields.label: 日期
fields.value: 2027 年 2 月香港学校农历新年假期，二世古 6 晚

fields.label: 成人和儿童年龄
fields.value: 2 位成人，孩子 7 岁和 11 岁

fields.label: 滑雪经验及教学语言
fields.value: 全家都是初学者，只有一位成人会一点滑雪

zh.template: 请帮我们安排从香港出发的二世古旅行：{dates}、{party}、{experience}、{budget}、{needs}。把已确认报价与预留款分开。推荐付款前，请把航班、全家床位、课程、雪票、接送和滑雪保险配好。联系任何人或预订前先问我。

phases.title: 从公开来源查学校假期日期、机票、接送、住宿和滑雪费用
phases.note: 住宿、机票接送、滑雪费用三条线同时调研
phases.judgment: 没找到的报价它没有硬编：目标那一周没有机票价格，也没有确认能订的家庭房，所以 2 月下旬的机票只当“参照”，不当“报价”。

phases.title: 做出“省钱版”和“舒适版”两份预算，写成页面和来源说明
phases.note: 全部以港元计价，每一步计算都列出
phases.judgment: 独立复核发现了一处漏洞：省钱方案在玩雪圈那天之前就还了租来的外套。修正后，省钱版总价为 HK$66,279（仍超出 6 万港元上限），严格压缩版为 HK$59,849（在 6 万港元上限下只剩 HK$151）。

phases.title: 用电脑和手机宽度打开页面，再核对一遍算术

workers: 查找二世古的真实住宿，记下公布的家庭价格、床位配置和预订与取消条款
查香港出发的航班、滑雪装备行李规定、机场到二世古的交通，以及入境和保险
整理本雪季的雪票、儿童与成人课程、租装备和玩雪圈价格，以及旺季日期规则
整理页面和来源说明的措辞，一个数字都不动
从原始数字出发重算每一行预算，独立于做预算的人
